```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r, include=FALSE}
### Loading Packages
library(data.table); library(tidyr); library(ggplot2); library(ggpubr)
library(dplyr); library(stringr); library(shiny)

# Resolve project path: prefer params, fallback to env var QPROJ_PATH, then cwd
qproj <- NULL
if (!is.null(params$qproj_path) && params$qproj_path != "") {
  qproj <- params$qproj_path
} else if (Sys.getenv("QPROJ_PATH", "") != "") {
  qproj <- Sys.getenv("QPROJ_PATH")
} else {
  qproj <- getwd()
}
qproj <- normalizePath(qproj, mustWork = FALSE)
message("Using project path: ", qproj)
```

```{r, include=FALSE}
##Reading Input Files:

# Find the first matching SHADE raw CSV (adjust pattern if needed)
shade_files <- list.files(path = qproj, pattern = "_raw\\.csv$", recursive = TRUE, full.names = TRUE, ignore.case = TRUE)
if (length(shade_files) == 0) stop("No SHADE CSV found under: ", qproj)
shade_raw <- read.csv(shade_files[1])

# Find anthracotic annotation CSVs
anno_files <- list.files(path = qproj, pattern = "_anth_anno\\.csv$", recursive = TRUE, full.names = TRUE, ignore.case = TRUE)
if (length(anno_files) == 0) stop("No anthracosis annotation CSV found under: ", qproj)
anth_anno <- read.csv(anno_files[1])
```

## Anthracosis detection overlay image
```{r, side-by-side, fig.show="hold", out.width="45%", fig.cap=c("Before SHADE", "After SHADE")}
# search for before/after images (adjust patterns if necessary)
before_img <- list.files(path = qproj, pattern = "_downsampled.*\\.jpg$", recursive = TRUE, full.names = TRUE, ignore.case = TRUE)[1]
after_img  <- list.files(path = qproj, pattern = "enhanced.*\\.png$", recursive = TRUE, full.names = TRUE, ignore.case = TRUE)[1]
```

| Original H&E | Original H&E with SHADE Annotations |
| :---: | :---: |
| ![](`r before_img`) | ![](`r after_img`) |

```{r}
## Generating SHADE score
shade_raw_anth = shade_raw %>% 
  filter(Classification =="Anthracosis")

area_anth = shade_raw_anth %>%
  mutate(Difference = Area.µm.2 - pick(ends_with("Other.area.µm.2"))[[1]])

tissue_area = shade_raw %>%
  filter(Classification =="Tissue")

data_ss = shade_raw_anth %>%
  select(Image)%>%
  mutate(shade_score = (area_anth$Difference / tissue_area$Area.µm.2) *100)
```

```{r}
knitr::kable(data_ss,
             caption = "SHADE Score")
```

## Anthracotic annotation histogram
```{r}
max_area <- max(anth_anno$Area.µm.2, na.rm = TRUE)

my_breaks = sort(unique(c(0.1, 2, 10, 100, 1000, max_area)))

anth_histo <- ggplot(anth_anno %>% 
         mutate(Temp_Bin = cut(Area.µm.2, breaks = my_breaks, include.lowest = TRUE)), 
       aes(x = Temp_Bin)) +
  geom_bar(fill = "steelblue", colour = "white") +
  scale_y_log10() +
  labs(title = "Distribution of Anthracotic Areas",
       x = "Area Range (µm²)",
       y = "Count (Log10)")
```

```{r}
plot(anth_histo)
```
